_help: Rooms of PawPrints MUCK. Exit names are 'name;alias;alias' (the first is shown). 'public': false keeps characters from wandering in. 'popularity' (default 1) makes characters more likely to hang out there.

welcome.name: Welcome Center
welcome.desc: A cozy lobby with a paw-print carpet worn thin by a thousand newbies. A huge corkboard is covered in flyers for fur-meets, roleplay groups and someone's lost plushie. A hand-painted sign over the desk reads: NEW HERE? TYPE 'help' -- AND BE NICE! The double doors lead out to the Town Square.

square.name: Town Square
square.desc: The heart of PawPrints. A big stone fountain splashes in the middle, topped by a bronze statue of a fox and a wolf sharing a laugh. Benches circle the fountain, and the smell of coffee drifts over from the cafe. Paths lead north to the park, east to the Tail-Wag Cafe, south to the boardwalk and west to the library. The arcade's neon sign buzzes nearby, and the Welcome Center is just behind you.

cafe.name: The Tail-Wag Cafe
cafe.desc: Overstuffed couches crowd around a crackling fireplace, and the espresso machine hisses like an angry cat. A chalkboard menu lists 'Mocha Mousse', 'Pupuccino' and 'Dragon Fire Chai'. A beat-up jukebox in the corner is stuck on Smash Mouth. The door west leads back to the square.

library.name: Fluffington Library
library.desc: Tall wooden shelves stretch up into the dim, and the air smells of old paper and lemon polish. A reading nook with beanbags sits under a round window. A small brass sign on the desk says: PLEASE PAGE, DON'T SHOUT. The exit east leads back to the square.

park.name: Pine Hollow Park
park.desc: Tall pines shade winding dirt paths, and a pond full of very spoiled ducks glitters in the middle. Picnic tables sit under the trees, one of them with a forgotten frisbee on it. A rope ladder dangles from a big old oak by the trail. The path south leads back to the square.

treehouse.name: Treehouse Lookout
treehouse.desc: A creaky wooden platform high in the old oak, with a blanket fort, a stack of comic books and a pair of binoculars on a nail. From up here you can see the whole town, all the way to the ocean. The rope ladder leads back down.

boardwalk.name: Seaside Boardwalk
boardwalk.desc: Weathered planks run along the shore. Seagulls wheel overhead, eyeing the ice cream stand with criminal intent. A row of coin-op binoculars faces the waves, and wooden stairs lead down to the beach. The square is back to the north.

beach.name: Sunset Beach
beach.desc: Warm sand and gentle waves. A ring of logs circles a bonfire pit, and somebody has built a lopsided sandcastle with a flag that reads 'OTTER KINGDOM'. The stairs lead back up to the boardwalk.

arcade.name: Pixel Paws Arcade
arcade.desc: Dark, loud and glowing. Rows of cabinets blink and beep: Street Fighter Alpha 3, Galaga, a Dance Dance Revolution machine with scuffed arrows, and a claw machine full of plushies nobody has ever won. The prize counter sells pencil toppers for an outrageous number of tickets. The exit leads back to the square.

home.name: {player}'s Den
home.desc: Your own little room on the MUCK: a beanbag, a lava lamp and a poster of your favorite band. It's quiet here. (Use '@describe here=...' to change this description.) The door leads out to the Town Square.
